name: Opening Range Drive
hypothesis: A tight London opening range (07:00-08:00 UTC) broken by an M15 close on clearly elevated tick volume with a decisive body and H1 agreement signals genuine participation; price travels multiples of the measured range from the breakout.
risk_model: One planned risk unit; stop at opening-range midpoint or 0.8 ATR floor; risk 0.6-5 ATR; no broker execution
known_limitations: No verified positive edge; UTC-fixed windows ignore DST; breakout models suffer in false-breakout regimes; CFD spread proxies; missing histories remain unresolved; tick volume is not centralized volume. Version history: 0.2.0: DST-aware London window (0.1.0 fixed UTC); volume confirmation 1.4x->1.8x median; range cap 3.0->2.5 ATR; body 0.35->0.4 ATR.
